headline: Cigarettes in Bulgaria to Cost 12 Cents More per Pack in 2027
summary: Economist Dimitar Sabev expects cigarette prices in Bulgaria to rise by an average of 12 cents per pack in 2027. The increase follows an excise duty rise of 6% to 120 euros in August, with a further adjustment planned for March.
why: Excise duties are a key fiscal revenue source for governments, and tobacco tax changes affect state budget income and tobacco company pricing.
